factual_errors.text: An ion is an atom with an overall charge.
factual_errors.correction: An ion is a charged particle. It forms when an atom loses (or gains) one or more electrons. By definition an atom has no overall charge, and the lesson says so two sentences earlier: "So an atom has no overall charge." Calling an ion "an atom with an overall charge" contradicts this. Suggested wording: "An ion is a charged particle formed when an atom loses or gains electrons." The specification says "In an atom the number of electrons is equal to the number of protons in the nucleus. Atoms have no overall electrical charge" and "Atoms turn into positive ions if they lose one or more outer electron(s)."
